id: 23_KVL and KCL complete virtual lab demonstration IIT Kharagpur
title: KVL与KCL虚拟实验完整演示
source_doc: course/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/23_KVL and KCL complete virtual lab demonstration IIT Kharagpur.md
author_source: project/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/23_KVL and KCL complete virtual lab demonstration IIT Kharagpur/src.py

points.K1: 电压定律：串联电压相加等于电源
points.K2: 电流定律：流入等于流出

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一块空白卡片，卡片上只有回路和节点两个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank card showing only a loop icon and a junction icon, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 两条定律，一起速记！

shots.scene: 阿杰考前在台灯下翻空白笔记，皱眉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student flips through a blank notebook under a desk lamp before an exam, frowning.
shots.narration: 考前，阿杰又把两条定律记混了。

shots.scene: 小研拿出两张卡片，一张画回路，一张画节点
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up two cards, one with a loop icon and one with a junction icon.
shots.narration: 小研说：一个看回路，一个看节点。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起秒表，笑着眨眼
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a stopwatch and winks.
shots.narration: 两张卡片，几分钟就能记牢。

shots.section_title: 电压定律：串联电压相加等于电源
shots.scene: 电源与两个电阻串联成回路，一个环形箭头绕回路一圈
shots.prompt_en: A circuit icon: a battery in series with two resistors forming a loop, with a circular arrow going around. No people.
shots.narration: 电压定律看回路。
overlay: 电压定律：串联电压相加等于电源

shots.section_title: 电压定律：串联电压相加等于电源
shots.scene: 阿杰用手指沿着回路描一圈
shots.prompt_en: The young male student traces the closed loop on the card with his finger.
shots.narration: 电源和R1、R2串成一个闭合回路。

shots.section_title: 电压定律：串联电压相加等于电源
shots.scene: 两个电阻上的电压条叠起来，和电源电压条一样高
shots.prompt_en: Two voltage bars for the two resistors stacked together, exactly as tall as the battery's voltage bar. No people.
shots.narration: 两个电阻的电压，叠起来一样高。

shots.section_title: 电压定律：串联电压相加等于电源
shots.scene: 叠起的电压条与电源条之间一个等号
shots.prompt_en: An equals sign between the stacked voltage bars and the battery voltage bar. No people.
shots.narration: 所以电阻电压之和等于电源电压。

shots.section_title: 电压定律：串联电压相加等于电源
shots.scene: R1、R2 两段分别高亮，再合在一起
shots.prompt_en: The two resistors R1 and R2 highlight one after the other, then together. No people.
shots.narration: V1在R1上，V2在R2上，合起来是Vs。

shots.section_title: 电压定律：串联电压相加等于电源
shots.scene: 欣欣沿着回路走一圈，回到起点
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot walks around a large loop drawn on the floor and returns to the start point.
shots.narration: 绕回路一圈，电压升降正好抵消。

shots.section_title: 电流定律：流入等于流出
shots.scene: 一个节点，一支粗箭头流入，两支细箭头流出
shots.prompt_en: A junction icon with one thick arrow flowing in and two thinner arrows flowing out. No people.
shots.narration: 电流定律看节点。
overlay: 电流定律：流入等于流出

shots.section_title: 电流定律：流入等于流出
shots.scene: 水管三通，一股水流分成两股
shots.prompt_en: A water pipe T-junction icon where one stream splits into two streams. No people.
shots.narration: 就像水管分岔，水不会凭空变多变少。

shots.section_title: 电流定律：流入等于流出
shots.scene: 流入箭头和两支流出箭头放在天平两端，正好平衡
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with one incoming arrow on one side and two outgoing arrows on the other, perfectly level. No people.
shots.narration: 流入和流出，两边总是相等。

shots.section_title: 电流定律：流入等于流出
shots.scene: 节点公式卡片
shots.prompt_en: A card with a junction formula in symbols only. No people.
shots.narration: 流进的电流，等于流出的电流之和。

shots.section_title: 电流定律：流入等于流出
shots.scene: 两支流出箭头合并回一支粗箭头
shots.prompt_en: The two outgoing arrows merge back into one thick arrow equal to the incoming one. No people.
shots.narration: I1加I2，正好等于总电流I。

shots.scene: 笔记本电脑屏幕上是空白的仿真电路图标
shots.prompt_en: A laptop screen showing a blank simulated circuit icon with small meters. No people.
shots.narration: 这两条定律，可以用仿真实验验证。

shots.scene: 靶心、阶梯、对勾三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a target, a staircase, and a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 好懂、分步，实验和考试都用得上。

shots.scene: 仿真界面上滑块移动，电表读数跟着变
shots.prompt_en: On the laptop screen, a slider moves and the small meter needles change. No people.
shots.narration: 在仿真里调电压，读出电压电流。

shots.scene: 读数相加，对上公式，打勾
shots.prompt_en: Blank reading cards added together match the formula card, and a green check appears. No people.
shots.narration: 读数一加一比，定律就验证了。

shots.scene: 欣欣指向一部播放按钮图标的屏幕
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a screen showing only a large play button icon.
shots.narration: 完整步骤，请看上一集的完整演示。

shots.scene: 播放器进度条一格格前进，旁边接线、记录、结论图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: A video progress bar advances step by step while icons for wiring, recording and conclusion light up in turn. No people.
shots.narration: 从接线到结论，一步一步演示。

shots.scene: 阿杰在电脑前跟着做，旁边空白笔记本
shots.prompt_en: The young male student follows along on a laptop with a blank notebook beside him.
shots.narration: 边看边做，记下每一步。

shots.scene: 回路图标和节点图标并排
shots.prompt_en: A loop icon and a junction icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 回路看电压，节点看电流。

shots.scene: 笔记本电脑和播放按钮图标
shots.prompt_en: A laptop icon next to a play button icon. No people.
shots.narration: 用仿真验证，步骤看完整演示。

shots.scene: 欣欣合上笔记本电脑，挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot closes a laptop and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 两条定律记住了，下次见！
